structure.unit: Commercial Code — Warehouse Receipts, Bills of Lading and Other Documents of Title

text.section:
Except as otherwise provided in subsection 3, a document is negotiable:
if by its terms the goods are to be delivered to bearer or to the order of a named person; or
where recognized in overseas trade, if it runs to a named person or assigns.

A document other than one described in subsection 1 is nonnegotiable. A bill of lading in which it is stated that the goods are consigned to a named person is not made negotiable by a provision that the goods are to be delivered only against an order in a record signed by the same or another named person.
A document is nonnegotiable if, at the time it is issued, the document has a conspicuous legend, however expressed, that it is nonnegotiable.
